headings.title: Nonprobate transfer agreements between owner and transferring entity
headings.reviewNote: Covers nonprobate transfer provisions as contractual agreements between owner and entity under mutually agreed terms.

headings.title: No statutory obligation on entity to accept nonprobate transfer request
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that nonprobate transfer statutes do not mandate transferring entity acceptance of owner requests.

headings.title: Entity acceptance relation back to time of request receipt
headings.reviewNote: Covers relation back of transferring entity acceptance to the date and time when the request was received.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text: nonprobate transfers as owner-entity agreements, absence of statutory acceptance obligation, and relation back of acceptance to receipt.

headings.title: Written assignment of contract rights effective on death
headings.reviewNote: Covers written assignments of contract performance taking effect on death, delivery or acknowledgment, and no consideration requirement.

headings.title: Other lawful contract assignment methods preserved
headings.reviewNote: Covers preservation of other lawful assignment methods that postpone contract enjoyment until the owner's death.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: written contract-right assignments effective on death (without consideration or delivery to beneficiary) and preservation of other lawful assignment methods.

headings.title: Beneficiary deeds conveying real property effective on death
headings.reviewNote: Covers execution and recording of beneficiary deeds conveying real property on death, lack of consideration, and transfers to trusts.

headings.title: Other conveyancing methods and post-death recording preserved
headings.reviewNote: Covers preservation of other lawful conveyancing methods and deeds otherwise effective not recorded until after death.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: recorded beneficiary deeds effective on death (including transfers to trusts) and preservation of other conveyancing methods and post-death recording.

headings.title: Beneficiary transfer instruments for tangible personal property
headings.reviewNote: Covers deeds of gift or bills of sale transferring tangible personal property on death, execution, acknowledgment, and delivery rules.

headings.title: Other personal property transfer methods preserved
headings.reviewNote: Covers preservation of other lawful methods transferring personal property ownership postponed until death.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: acknowledged beneficiary transfer instruments for tangible personal property effective on death and preservation of other lawful methods.

headings.title: Direct transfer to transferee holding as owner in beneficiary form
headings.reviewNote: Covers direct property transfers to transferees to hold as owners in beneficiary form with or without consideration.

headings.title: Transferee ownership rights including revocation and change
headings.reviewNote: Declares a transferee under subsection 1 to be the owner for all purposes with all legal ownership rights, including the right to revoke or change the beneficiary designation.

headings.title: Effective time of direct transfer in beneficiary form
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a direct transfer to a transferee to hold as owner in beneficiary form takes effect when the writing perfecting the transfer becomes effective to make the transferee the owner.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified subsection 1 and replaced inaccurate/hallucinated draft headings in subsections 2 (transferee ownership rights including revocation/change) and 3 (effective time of direct transfer, not life estates/concurrent interests).

headings.title: Registration of property in beneficiary form
headings.reviewNote: Covers holding and registering property in beneficiary form by including transfer on death directions in title.

headings.title: Statutory wording and abbreviations for transfer on death registration
headings.reviewNote: Covers approved phrasing including transfer on death to, pay on death to, and abbreviations TOD or POD.

headings.title: Authority required to place transfer on death direction on records
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that transfer on death directions may only be placed on records by transferring entities or authorized persons.

headings.title: Effective transfer on death upon pre-death registration or delivery
headings.reviewNote: Covers effective transfer of owner's interest to designated beneficiary upon death if registered or request delivered prior to death.

headings.title: Conclusive evidence of regular registration and record retention limit
headings.reviewNote: Covers registration as conclusive evidence absent fraud or clerical error, and six-month record retention rule following account statement.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections against archived text: beneficiary-form registration, TOD/POD wording, entity placement authority, pre-death registration/delivery effect, and conclusive evidence with 6-month record retention limit.

headings.title: Beneficiary has no lifetime rights or transaction consent authority
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that designated beneficiaries have no property rights prior to owner's death and consent is not required for transactions.

headings.title: Survivorship rights of joint owners take precedence
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that upon death of one joint owner, property belongs to surviving joint owners and beneficiary designation remains pending.

headings.title: Passage of property by operation of law on owner's death
headings.reviewNote: Covers automatic passage of property to designated beneficiary by operation of law upon owner's death.

headings.title: Tenancy in common among surviving beneficiaries absent survivorship
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that multiple surviving beneficiaries hold as tenants in common unless designation expressly provides for survivorship.

headings.title: Property passes to owner's estate if no beneficiary survives
headings.reviewNote: Covers reversion of property to the owner's probate estate if no designated beneficiary survives the owner.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections against archived text: no lifetime beneficiary rights, joint owner survivorship precedence, passage by operation of law, tenancy in common among multiple beneficiaries, and reversion to owner's estate.

headings.title: Owner right to revoke or change beneficiary designation
headings.reviewNote: Covers owner's unilateral authority to revoke or change beneficiary designations prior to death without beneficiary consent.

headings.title: Subsequent beneficiary designation revokes prior designation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a subsequent beneficiary designation revokes a prior beneficiary designation unless the subsequent designation expressly provides otherwise.

headings.title: Compliance with instrument, entity rules, and applicable law
headings.reviewNote: Requires any revocation or change in a beneficiary designation to comply with the governing instrument, transferring entity rules, and applicable law.

headings.title: Beneficiary designations not revocable by will absent express grant
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that beneficiary designations cannot be revoked or changed by will unless designation expressly authorizes testamentary change.

headings.title: Lifetime property transfer terminates beneficiary designation
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that lifetime transfer of owner's property interest terminates the beneficiary designation with respect to that property.

headings.title: Determination of effective date of revocation or change
headings.reviewNote: Covers determination of effective dates for revocations and changes in the same manner as original beneficiary designations.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified subsections 1 and 4–6 and replaced wrong draft headings in subsections 2 (subsequent designation revokes prior designation) and 3 (compliance with governing instrument, entity rules, and applicable law).

headings.title: Agent authority to make or revoke beneficiary designations
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that attorneys-in-fact, conservators, or agents cannot make or change designations absent express document or court authority.

headings.title: Present transfer by authorized agent extinguishing beneficiary rights
headings.reviewNote: Covers validity of authorized present withdrawals, sales, or transfers by agents even if extinguishing beneficiary expectancy.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: bar on agent beneficiary changes absent express document or court authority, and preservation of authorized present transfers extinguishing beneficiary expectancy.

headings.title: Beneficiary takes property subject to lifetime encumbrances and liens
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that nonprobate transferees take property subject to all conveyances, contracts, liens, and security interests of owner.

headings.title: Account beneficiaries subject to unsatisfied lifetime payment requests
headings.reviewNote: Covers account beneficiary liability for owner's unpaid lifetime payment requests, estate subrogation, pro rata liability, and contribution.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: beneficiaries taking subject to lifetime encumbrances/liens and account beneficiary liability/subrogation/contribution for owner's lifetime payment requests.

headings.title: One hundred twenty-hour survival requirement for beneficiaries
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory requirement that nonprobate transfer beneficiaries survive the owner by 120 hours to take property.

headings.title: Different survival periods specified by agreement or instrument
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization for owners and transferring entities to specify different survival periods or presumptions in instruments.

headings.title: Inapplicability to joint tenancy survivorship rights
headings.reviewNote: Covers provision that statutory 120-hour survival requirement does not apply to survivorship rights of joint owners.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text: 120-hour survival requirement, alternative agreed/instrument survival periods, and inapplicability to joint owner survivorship.

headings.title: Validity of trustee designation under amendable or revocable trust
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that designating a trustee under an amendable, revocable, or post-designation amended trust is valid.

headings.title: Pre-death revoked or terminated trust deemed non-surviving
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that a designated trust revoked or terminated prior to the owner's death is deemed not to have survived the owner.

headings.title: Non-existent entity or trust deemed non-surviving
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that legal entities or trusts not in existence at owner's death are deemed not to have survived the owner.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text: validity of designations to amendable/revocable trusts and nonsurvival treatment of pre-death revoked/terminated or nonexistent trusts and entities.

headings.title: Lineal descendants per stirpes substitute for deceased descendant
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that deceased lineal descendant beneficiary shares pass to their surviving descendants per stirpes absent no LDPS notation.

headings.title: LDPS designation for non-lineal descendant beneficiaries
headings.reviewNote: Covers express authorization to add LDPS or lineal descendants per stirpes notation to non-descendant beneficiary designations.

headings.title: Per stirpes distribution by representation among unequal degrees
headings.reviewNote: Covers distribution equally among descendants of same degree and by representation for descendants of more remote degrees.

headings.title: Intestate succession rules determine substitute proportions
headings.reviewNote: Covers application of Missouri intestate personal property succession laws to determine substitute proportions among descendants.

headings.title: Failure of substitute descendants reverts to surviving beneficiaries
headings.reviewNote: Covers passage of deceased beneficiary share to other surviving beneficiaries or estate if no lineal descendants survive.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections against archived text: lineal descendant per stirpes substitution (absent "no LDPS"), express LDPS for non-descendants, representation distribution, intestate proportions, and fallback if no descendants survive.

headings.title: Automatic revocation of provisions for former spouse upon dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Covers automatic revocation of beneficiary designations in favor of former spouse or former spouse's relatives upon divorce or annulment.

headings.title: Exceptions for irrevocable designations or post-dissolution agreements
headings.reviewNote: Covers exceptions for irrevocable designations, express post-dissolution designations, and agreements maintaining beneficiary status.

headings.title: Revival of revoked provisions upon remarriage to former spouse
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory revival of revoked beneficiary provisions upon remarriage to former spouse or nullification of divorce.

headings.title: Relative of former spouse defined
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory definition of relative of former spouse related by blood, adoption, or affinity who is not related to owner.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections against archived text (noting 2001 Egelhoff ERISA preemption annotation): divorce/annulment revocation for former spouse and relatives, exceptions, remarriage/nullification revival, and definition.

headings.title: Beneficiary designations procured by fraud, duress, or undue influence void
headings.reviewNote: Covers invalidation and void status of beneficiary designations or revocations procured through fraud, duress, or undue influence.

headings.title: Disqualification of beneficiary causing death of owner or insured
headings.reviewNote: Covers slayer rule disqualifying beneficiaries willfully causing death of owner or insured, treating disqualification as disclaimer.

headings.title: Petition to determine voidness or disqualification, mitigation, and jury
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes any interested person or transferring entity to petition the trier of fact to determine voidness under subsection 1 or slayer disqualification under subsection 2, allows justice-based mitigation, and grants a right to demand a jury trial.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified subsections 1 and 2 (noting 1998 Groh and 2014 Ivie annotations) and broadened subsection 3 heading/reviewNote to cover petitions on both voidness and slayer disqualification, mitigation, and jury trial demand.

headings.title: Omitted spouse and child pretermission statutes inapplicable
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that testamentary pretermission statutes protecting omitted spouses or children do not apply to nonprobate transfers.

headings.title: Class gift designations include after-born and adopted children
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that beneficiary designations to children as a class include all children born or adopted before or after designation.

headings.title: After-born child share from nonprobate transfer to other children
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory entitlement of after-born or after-adopted child to proportionate fractional share of property given to other children.

headings.title: Agreement or designation may negate after-born child rule
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization in governing instrument or transfer rules to negate the statutory after-born child allocation.

headings.title: Transferring entity exempt from calculating after-born child shares
headings.reviewNote: Covers transferring entity exemption relieving entity from duty to calculate or distribute after-born child shares on registered property.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections against archived text: inapplicability of probate pretermission statutes, class-gift inclusion, after-born/after-adopted fractional share formula, express negation, and transferring entity calculation exemption.

headings.title: Governing law of Missouri nonprobate transfers
headings.reviewNote: Covers application of Missouri nonprobate transfers law to determine rights and obligations of owners, beneficiaries, and entities.

headings.title: Transferring entity authority to adopt operational rules
headings.reviewNote: Covers authority of transferring entities to establish operational rules governing beneficiary designations and transfers.

headings.title: Statutory default construction rules for beneficiary designations
headings.reviewNote: Covers fifteen standard statutory construction rules governing fractional shares, custodial transfers, identification, and execution.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text: Missouri governing law, transferring entity operational rules, and fifteen default construction and execution rules.

headings.title: Statutory protections for transferring entities executing transfers
headings.reviewNote: Covers broad statutory protections granted to transferring entities executing nonprobate transfers under sections 461.003 to 461.081.

headings.title: Execution of transfer with or without written request
headings.reviewNote: Covers transferring entity discretion to execute nonprobate transfers with or without receiving formal written requests.

headings.title: Entity reliance on certified death certificates and official records
headings.reviewNote: Covers entity reliance on official death certificates, military records, and court adjudications without duty of inquiry.

headings.title: Entity reliance on written requests without verification duty
headings.reviewNote: Covers entity reliance on beneficiary written requests, identification, and affidavits without independent duty of verification.

headings.title: No entity duty to give notice, locate beneficiaries, or investigate
headings.reviewNote: Covers absence of entity duties to notify interested parties, locate beneficiaries, confirm survival, or investigate marriages.

headings.title: Adverse claim notice and thirty-day withholding procedure
headings.reviewNote: Relieves transferring entities of any duty to withhold transfer absent timely written adverse claim notice containing four required elements, and allows discharging any duty via certified-mail 30-day withholding notice unless restrained by court order.

headings.title: No entity responsibility for application of funds by fiduciaries
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that transferring entities bear no responsibility for the subsequent application or use of funds transferred to fiduciaries.

headings.title: Adjudication or indemnity bond for uncertain or disputed transfers
headings.reviewNote: Permits a transferring entity facing uncertainty or dispute over beneficiary entitlement or shares to require parties to adjudicate their rights or furnish an indemnity bond.

headings.title: Complete discharge of entity upon good-faith statutory transfer
headings.reviewNote: Covers complete release and discharge of transferring entity from all claims upon executing nonprobate transfer in good faith.

headings.title: Protections cumulative to commercial code and trust law protections
headings.reviewNote: Covers provision that transferring entity protections under nonprobate transfers law are in addition to chapters 400, 403, 404, and 456.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified subsections 1–5, 7, 9, and 10 and corrected headings in subsections 6 (adverse claim notice and 30-day withholding procedure; removed unstated bond) and 8 (adjudication or indemnity bond, not interpleader/judicial discharge).

headings.title: Entity protections do not prejudice claimant rights against transferee
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that statutory protections for transferring entities do not affect substantive rights between claimants and transferees.

headings.title: Transferee liability to return improper payment or transfer
headings.reviewNote: Covers liability of transferee receiving improper transfer to return property or value to rightful claimant or estate.

headings.title: Protection of bona fide purchasers and lenders from transferees
headings.reviewNote: Covers protection for good-faith purchasers for value and lenders acquiring security interests from transferee after owner's death.

headings.title: Entity immunity for good-faith execution of improper transfers
headings.reviewNote: Covers complete immunity for transferring entity executing improper transfers honestly and in good faith reliance on records.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections against archived text: preservation of inter-claimant disputes, improper transferee return/encumbrance-release liability, bona fide purchaser/lender protection, and entity good-faith immunity for §§ 461.045–461.059 errors.

headings.title: Territorial application to Missouri owners, property, and entities
headings.reviewNote: Covers territorial application of Missouri nonprobate transfer laws based on owner domicile, property location, or entity place of business.

headings.title: Ongoing obligation to execute transfer regardless of location changes
headings.reviewNote: Covers continued obligation to execute nonprobate transfers under Missouri law regardless of subsequent owner or entity location changes.

headings.title: Exclusion of bank accounts absent express statutory incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Covers exclusion of bank and financial institution accounts unless account contract expressly incorporates sections 461.003 to 461.081.

headings.title: Applicability to Missouri personal custodian directions
headings.reviewNote: Covers application of nonprobate transfer rules to transfer on death directions under Missouri personal custodian law.

headings.title: Exclusion of motor vehicle certificates of title
headings.reviewNote: Covers exclusion of Department of Revenue motor vehicle, vessel, and outboard motor certificates of ownership from general nonprobate rules.

headings.title: Exclusion of life insurance company policies and products
headings.reviewNote: Excludes life or accidental death insurance policies, annuities, contracts, plans, or other products sold or issued by a life insurance company from listed nonprobate sections unless expressly incorporated.

headings.title: Exclusion where governing instrument expressly provides other law
headings.reviewNote: Covers non-applicability of statutory sections where governing instrument or contract expressly provides that other law governs.

headings.title: Divorce revocation rule inapplicable to ERISA benefit plans
headings.reviewNote: Covers exemption providing that section 461.051 marriage dissolution revocation rules do not apply to ERISA-governed employee benefit plans.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified subsections 1–5, 7, and 8 and corrected subsection 6 heading/reviewNote (excludes life insurance company policies/products absent incorporation; ERISA employee benefit plans are in subsection 8).

headings.title: Enforcement of nonprobate transfers valid under laws of other states
headings.reviewNote: Covers recognition, execution, and enforcement in Missouri of beneficiary designations valid under Uniform TOD Security laws of other states.

headings.title: Choice of law governing meaning and legal effect
headings.reviewNote: Covers determination of meaning and legal effect of nonprobate transfers by local law of jurisdiction selected in governing instrument.

headings.title: Uniform statutory construction among enacting states
headings.reviewNote: Covers general rule of statutory construction to effectuate uniform application among states enacting similar nonprobate transfer laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text: Missouri enforcement of beneficiary designations valid under another state's law, choice of local law selected in instrument, and uniform construction.

headings.title: Effective dates for designations and nonprobate transfers
headings.reviewNote: Covers application of sections 461.003 to 461.081 to designations made on or after August 28, 1989, and transfers on or after January 1, 1990.

headings.title: Validation of pre-1989 nonprobate transfers
headings.reviewNote: Covers retroactive statutory validation of nonprobate transfer provisions made prior to August 28, 1989.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: August 28, 1989 designation and January 1, 1990 transfer effective dates, and retroactive validation of pre-August 28, 1989 nonprobate transfer provisions.

headings.title: Action for accounting of recoverable transfers to pay estate claims
headings.reviewNote: Covers personal representative action for accounting against nonprobate transferees to satisfy unpaid estate claims and allowances.

headings.title: Qualified claimant demand and eighteen-month limitation period
headings.reviewNote: Sets an 18-month limitation period from death for accounting actions by personal representatives or qualified claimants (requiring written demand within 16 months and 30-day wait), disclosure and tolling rules, and administrator ad litem appointment.

headings.title: Judgment accounting for administration expenses and proceeding costs
headings.reviewNote: Covers accounting judgment taking into account additional estate administration costs, with proceeding costs and attorney fees treated as expenses.

headings.title: Joinder of other recipients and personal representative liability
headings.reviewNote: Covers joinder of other transfer recipients within 18 months, and full non-pro-rata liability of personal representatives joined thereafter.

headings.title: Transferring entity execution rights preserved absent served process
headings.reviewNote: Covers right of transferring entities to execute death transfers without liability absent prior service of process in accounting proceeding.

headings.title: No automatic lien on recoverable transfer property
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that accounting statute does not create automatic lien on recoverable property except as perfected by attachment or judgment.

headings.title: Probate division jurisdiction and probate code application
headings.reviewNote: Covers probate division jurisdiction to hear accounting actions and application of section 472.013 probate fraud remedies.

headings.title: Trust assets and joint tenancy accounts subject to accounting
headings.reviewNote: Covers liability of revocable trust assets and joint tenancy property subject to debts immediately prior to death, to extent of contribution.

headings.title: Applicability to actions commenced after August 28, 1995
headings.reviewNote: Covers applicability of accounting provisions to actions commenced after August 28, 1995, and two-year transition period for prior deaths.

headings.title: Definitions for creditor, dependent child, qualified claimant, and recoverable transfer
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory definitions for creditor, dependent child, qualified claimant, and recoverable transfer.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 10 subsections against archived text (noting 2009 In re Estate of Jones and 2014 Citizens-Farmers Bank annotations); removed unstated "security for costs" from subsection 2 reviewNote.
